standard_prerequisites: the equivalence between QCoh(O_S) on an affine scheme and the category of A-modules

the structure theorem for injective modules over a Noetherian ring: every injective is a direct sum of indecomposable injectives, each the injective hull of a residue field (Dualizing Complexes, Proposition dualizing-proposition-structure-injectives-noetherian)
the description of the injective hull of kappa(p) as the union of its Artinian submodules J[p^n], the injective hulls over A_p/p^n A_p (Dualizing Complexes, Lemma dualizing-lemma-union-artinian)
finiteness of the pieces (Dualizing Complexes, Lemma dualizing-lemma-finite)
core_obligations: Prove that every injective object of QCoh(O_S) for S Noetherian affine is a filtered colimit of quasi-coherent sheaves F_i = (Z_i -> S)_* G_i where Z_i is the spectrum of an Artinian ring and G_i is a coherent module on Z_i
proof_roadmap: Identify the injective quasi-coherent sheaf with tilde J for an injective A-module J, and decompose J into a direct sum of injective hulls of residue fields; finite disjoint unions of Artinian schemes are Artinian, so it suffices to handle a single injective hull of kappa(p).
For J the injective hull of kappa(p), write J as the union of its submodules J[p^n], each the injective hull of kappa(p) over the Artinian ring A_p/p^n A_p (union lemma of Dualizing Complexes).

Then tilde J is the colimit of the pushforwards from the Artinian closed subschemes Spec(A_p/p^n A_p) with coherent sheaves attached to the finite modules J[p^n]; finiteness of the pieces follows from the finiteness lemma.
difficulty_reason: H2: a structure-theorem argument, decomposing injectives and writing each hull as an increasing union of Artinian pieces.
